items.sourceHeadline: Iran war makes multibillion-dollar Tanzania LNG more attractive, Equinor says
items.sourceDescription: Equinor says Hormuz energy disruption improves the strategic case for Tanzania's long-stalled LNG export project, estimated by Tanzania at about $42 billion and tied to 47.13 trillion cubic feet of gas. Investment terms remain under negotiation; no final investment decision was reported.
items.whyItMatters: Geopolitical supply risk can improve Tanzania's bargaining position, but attractiveness is not execution. The unresolved issue is whether negotiated terms convert urgency into durable domestic value.
items.inferenceOrUnresolved: No final investment decision was reported.

items.sourceHeadline: Two UN peacekeepers killed in South Sudan ambush, UN says
items.sourceDescription: Two Ethiopian UN peacekeepers were killed and seven other people injured in what the UN described as a deliberately targeted patrol ambush in South Sudan's Jonglei State. The attackers remain unidentified, and the UN called for a prompt investigation.
items.whyItMatters: Regional security cooperation depends on peacekeepers being able to operate without impunity. Accountability, not only force presence, is the unresolved institutional test.
items.inferenceOrUnresolved: The attackers had not been identified at publication.

items.sourceHeadline: Kenya arrests four in probe into 18 elephant deaths in Amboseli
items.sourceDescription: Kenyan authorities arrested four suspects and recovered chemicals while investigating 18 elephant deaths in the Amboseli ecosystem; the suspects were later released on bail. Preliminary findings point toward a toxic substance, but experts dispute the pesticide explanation and authorities say no culpability has been established.
items.whyItMatters: The evidence remains unsettled. The material question is whether the investigation can separate farm-wildlife conflict from deliberate poisoning without converting suspicion into a completed narrative.
items.inferenceOrUnresolved: Cause and culpability remain under investigation.
